cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate: C1 chassis, Sodium Laureth Sulfate @2 with prominent buffer Cocamidopropyl Betaine @4, no reinforcing strong anionic (C3, C4, C1). Fatty alcohols and cationics are counter-signals only.

conditioningLevel.rationale: High: rich architecture (W-RICH, E3 reading for conditioning) - a prominent fatty-alcohol payload lipid (Stearyl Alcohol @6) converges with cationic deposition (Polyquaternium-6 @14, Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride @15), supported by Cetyl Alcohol @9, Trihydroxystearin @17 and humectants (Glycerin @12, Panthenol @20, Sodium Hyaluronate @23). C2 is also satisfied on the lipid-substitute reading (prominent fatty alcohol in place of the silicone; cationic polymer; fatty route Cetyl Alcohol; humectant Glycerin). Counter-signal: both cationics and all humectants are post-fragrance, so moderate is the realistic neighbor.

weightPotential.depositionLoad: moderate - a material fatty alcohol plus two (post-fragrance) cationic polymers; further fatty/waxy lipids post-line
weightPotential.persistence: moderate - fatty alcohol/cationic gel-network deposits are substantive but rinse-off
weightPotential.counterevidence: W-RICH is met for weight (material Stearyl Alcohol @6 + cationic partners, no position test on the partner); two cationic polymers plus a lipid = convergence on paper; post-line Cetyl Alcohol @9 and Trihydroxystearin @17 add lipid load.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: Noticeable but bounded residue from a fatty-alcohol/cationic system (6.6 moderate anchor).
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not high: W-RICH is present but resetCapacity is moderate (effective C1 SLES chassis), so the rich route lacks limited reset; the convergence route rests on one material lipid and two cationics that are both post-fragrance trace, which the SLES/betaine reset plausibly offsets; the further lipids (Cetyl Alcohol @9, Trihydroxystearin @17) are at or after the W-line and do not count toward high (W-LINE item 6: confidence at most moderate, neighbor high). Not low: two deposition families with a material lipid (W2).
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: W-RICH with moderate reset; post-line lipids named as what keeps it from high (W-LINE 6)
weightPotential.rationale: Moderate: W-RICH without limited reset; post-line lipids recorded as counter-signal (6.6, W-RICH, W-LINE, W2). Neighbor high.
